source_question: Exact weight-spectral kernel and rational polarizable Hodge lift for a smooth projective variety minus a simple-normal-crossings divisor.

sources.author: Pierre Deligne
sources.title: Theorie de Hodge II
sources.version: Published original, Publications mathematiques de l'IHES 40 (1971), pages 5-57
sources.authentication: Author institutional publication record and linked original published scan inspected.
sources.extraction: Residue description yields the intersections of boundary components with Tate twists. The reindexed weight sequence has pure rows and degenerates at E2; the differently indexed Leray sequence degenerates at E3. Smooth-projective rational cohomology is polarizable.
sources.translation: Published compactification and its open are Y and U here. In the E1 convention E1^{-s,t}=H^{t-2s}(D^{(s)},Q)(-s). The adjacent incoming first differential is the sum of component Gysin maps. Its image is the kernel of restriction from Y.
sources.application_verdict: verified for the stated smooth-projective SNC hypotheses
sources.derived_here: The edge kernel, rational lift through the polarized kernel complement, denominator-cleared original-X cycle return and smooth-ample test are written in the companion derivation.
sources.acquisition_note: Direct Numdam PDF retrieval timed out; the author's IAS-hosted published scan was accessible. No full source copied into the repository.

reused_dependencies: The project's previously proved projective return and canonical cycle comparison.

Classical exponential exact sequence, projective GAGA, rational Lefschetz (1,1), weak and hard Lefschetz, and embedded resolution under their standard complex smooth-projective hypotheses. These are existing branch inputs, not claimed as GST inventions.
overlap: Standard Hodge-theoretic mechanisms and classical quadric cycles; no historical novelty claim or exhaustive literature search.
